genetic_map.averaging: equal-weight mean of the population maps' cM, each interpolated (linear between its points, flat beyond its ends) at the union of their positions
genetic_map.interpolation: linear between map points; flat beyond a chromosome's ends; NaN off the map

prominence.profile: the Analysis's observed rows in the 5e-4 Top-Hit tier, every one of them, including rows outside the shared set (off the panel, for example)
prominence.envelope: per chromosome, bins of B bp fixed from position 0 (bin = position // B); a bin's envelope is the largest |z| among the profile's rows in it, and 0 when it holds none
prominence.col: between two rows on one chromosome, the lowest envelope over the bins from one row's bin to the other's, both included
prominence.order: abs_z descending, then Store Variant Index ascending (the Locus Lead ranking)
prominence.join: a candidate joins the strongest (first accepted) lead on its chromosome at most 10,000,000 bp away whose col is above the candidate's threshold; otherwise it becomes a lead
prominence.relative: threshold = f x the candidate's own |z|
prominence.fixed: threshold = T; with T = 0, a chain of bins that all hold a tier row

ld_blocks.blocks: the rows of the LD-region file for the ancestry, each half-open [start, end), so a row at a shared endpoint belongs to the block that starts there
ld_blocks.lead: the block's strongest row: abs_z descending, then Store Variant Index ascending
ld_blocks.outside: a row outside every block belongs to the stretch between blocks it falls in (before a chromosome's first block, between two, after its last, or the whole of a chromosome without blocks); each stretch holds one lead, and those rows and stretches are counted

valleys.sample: per bin width B, up to 200 of the distinct (Store, Analysis, chromosome, bin) valleys with no tier row, over every prominence rule at full density, drawn by random.Random(409).sample from their sorted list
valleys.cells: every variant of the Store's Variant Index in the bin [bin x B, (bin + 1) x B - 1], read for the Analysis through the query facade's lookup
valleys.low_z: the bin holds at least one observed cell (all below the tier's floor, |z| < 3.4808)
valleys.missing_cells: the bin holds Store variants but none with an observed cell for the Analysis (missing, or imputed only)
valleys.no_variant: the Store's Variant Index holds no variant in the bin
valleys.stop_rule: more than half of a sample's valleys are gaps: the profile cannot tell a valley from a gap in coverage

definitions.shared_set: the candidates' shared set must equal the shared set of the 5e-8 tier, read now with #403's read_tier and built with its build_shared_set: the same row count and sha256 of Store, Analysis and sorted Store Variant Indices. Both must reproduce #403's committed summaries: its accounting, its HapMap3 row counts and its distance rules' records. #403 committed no digest, so the digest published is of the current reads, and matches_403_summaries says only that the summaries are reproduced

criteria.C1: rank. Spearman rho(Locus Leads, r2 0.01 index variants) over the swept Analyses is >= 0.95.
criteria.C2: density. For each swept Analysis, restrict the shared set to HapMap3 variants and recompute the leads at every (D, W) and bp-only; no re-clumping. Density ratio = leads(HM3) / leads(full). C2 holds when the median ratio over Analyses is in [0.8, 1.25] and its median |log2| is at most half that of the same ratio for raw row counts (rows(HM3) / rows(full)).
criteria.C3: cM against bp-only, at the same W. cM adds value when its best D improves on bp-only by at least 0.01 in rho (C1) or by at least 0.1 in median |log2 density ratio| (C2), without being worse on the other by more than those margins.
criteria.c2_profile: for C2 the HapMap3 restriction applies to the 5e-4 profile as well as to the 5e-8 candidates: both are cut to HapMap3 ALIDs before a rule runs; the raw-row ratio C2 compares with is #403's, from the same shared set
criteria.c3_reading: a rule has no W, so at each W of #403's grid it is compared with that W's bp-only window: C3 holds when it improves on bp-only by at least one margin and is worse on neither by more than its margin (#403's test); W 10 Mb is #403's named point
criteria.index_variants: plink2 at r2 0.01, on the same shared set as the leads

beats.overall: rank: rho at least c3_margin_rho above bp-only's at that W, and median |log2| not worse by more than c3_margin_abs_log2
beats.hapmap3: density: median |log2| at least c3_margin_abs_log2 below bp-only's at that W, and rho not worse by more than c3_margin_rho
beats.strong_peaks: in the lead's |z| band [20,inf), the pooled disagreement rate (spurious splits + lost signals) / (Locus Leads + index variants) is at most 0.90 of the distance rule's, for each rule set beside
